thread:
andrew.t: Heads up — just after the v13 SDK canary pushed to our streaming client pool we started seeing a spike in client reconnects and 5xxs from the streaming gateway. Noticed ~30% of persistent connections drop within the first 20s of a session.

sre_jin: Incident bot: new incident created: INC-20260315-01 — sdk v13 streaming handshake regression. Paging primary on-call.

marie.p: @sre_jin I'm seeing the same in telemetry — handshake failures with 'unexpected frame type' and some JSON parse errors when the client sends the initial init frame.

andrew.t: Stack traces look like a protocol mismatch. v13 changed the initial control envelope shape (we added an optional metadata block), seems some server-side decoder variant is treating it as an invalid payload.

ops-bot: DeployBot: canary rollout to streaming-cluster-a completed at 3732109920. Canary percentage: 10%.

oncall-sv: I'm on it. Have we killed the feature flag for v13 clients yet?

andrew.t: Not yet — can we toggle sdk_v13_stream and stop further canaries?

marie.p: Doing it now: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"sdk_v13_stream","state":"off"}'` 

marie.p: Flag toggle confirmed. Blocking new v13 clients from being routed to canary.

andrew.t: Confirmed — new handshake error rate drops, but existing canary sessions still failing. We should fallback them to v12.

oncall-sv: Agreed. Initiating immediate rollback of the canary deployment. Command: `kubectl -n streaming rollout undo deployment/streaming-gateway --to-revision=12`

ops-bot: DeployBot: rollback started at 3732110200 by oncall-sv.

dave.r: Patching routing to redirect incoming 'client-version:13' to the compatibility proxy that enforces v12 envelope for a quick shim while we patch the decoder. Will push proxy fix in 5 min.

eve.k: Quick heads-up — support queue already getting one-off customer reports: intermittent disconnected sessions in embeddings-stream. I filed CS ticket CS-1248 with initial customer impact.

andrew.t: Can we quantify impacted customers? Telemetry shows ~4% of all streaming sessions from yesterday 00:00-06:00 UTC used v13 (early canary signups), but in last 30m failure rate for those sessions is ~60%. Rough estimate: ~1200 sessions affected, ~25 customers with >10% session failures.

marie.p: I'm collating affected customer IDs and adding to the incident doc. Quick mitigation: backend will accept the v13 envelope if metadata block is present as a one-off permissive parse mode — but that requires a small hotfix and restart. Prefer rollback + proxy as lower risk.

oncall-sv: TL;DR: feature flag killed, canary rollback in progress, proxy shim being deployed to catch remaining traffic. Notify support and PMs.

ops-bot: Incident bot: oncall handoff — oncall-sv accepted at 3732110600. Severity set to sev2.

andrew.t: Diffs: v12->v13 change that broke us: added optional `meta` object to init frame JSON. Server decode expected `connection_id` first; now `meta` at top-level shifts parsing in the legacy code path. Code snippet from client v13: ```json
{"meta":{"env":"prod"},"connection_id":"...","capabilities":{}}
```

sre_jin: Hotfix plan if rollback/proxy incomplete: patch streaming decoder to check for `meta` at top-level and tolerate it for 1.2 release cycle. Patch + restart streaming-gateway pods (rolling restart, 60s drain). Will prepare PR.

marie.p: Support note draft: "We've detected an SDK release (v13) that caused a streaming handshake regression for a subset of connections. We've disabled the v13 routing flag and rolled back the canary; sessions should recover as traffic drains. If your application is still affected, please open ticket CS-1248 and attach a sample init frame." :thumbsup:

dave.r: Proxy shim deployed to cluster-a and cluster-b at 3732111400. It rewrites the init frame to move `meta` under `connection_meta` before sending to legacy decoder. Initial telemetry shows handshake failure rate down to ~8% for canary sessions.

eve.k: Support: routing the customers with persistent issues to priority queue. Notifying top 5 affected accounts now.

andrew.t: For postmortem: need to add a gate in the SDK release checklist to add backward compatibility tests against old decoders, and require a cross-team review when schema changes touch transport envelopes. Also add an automated contract test in the CI that runs a lightweight server emulator expecting both v12 and v13 init envelopes.

sre_jin: Current status: rollback finished at 3732112200; proxy shim live; hotfix PR opened (link) and targeting quick patch if any residual fails. Impacted sessions trending down.

ops-bot: Incident bot: incident updated to monitoring at 3732113000.

marie.p: I'll send a short customer-facing summary and coordinate follow-up with SDK team and QA to backfill tests.

oncall-sv: Leaving notes for next on-call: watch for residual reconnect spikes and CS escalations. Assigning follow-ups: postmortem owner = andrew.t, QA action = marie.p, SDK compat test = dave.r.

andrew.t: Thanks everyone — good catch and fast rollback. We'll lock the SDK branch and open a patch release for v13 with compatibility shim and tests.

ops-bot: Incident bot: incident resolved->post-incident review pending at 3732113620.
